scientific_scope_status: For a trace-preserving conditional expectation E from a full matrix algebra onto a unital subalgebra with multiplicities m_i, the complete Pimsner–Popa order index is C=Σ_i m_i² and the conditional/equal-conditioned contraction coefficient of Φλ=λid+(1−λ)E is (C−1)λ²/[1+(C−2)λ] throughout the full completely-positive interval −1/(C−1)≤λ≤1.
